d: We are seeking an experienced Senior Internal Controller to join a growing Organisation in Kuwait. The successful candidate will play a key role in strengthening internal controls, managing business risks, and ensuring effective governance across retail, manufacturing, and corporate operations.
q: Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field.
5–7 years of experience in Internal Control, Risk Management, GRC, ICFR, or Risk Advisory.
Big Four Risk Advisory experience is highly preferred.
Strong knowledge of internal control frameworks, risk assessment, and control testing.
Experience in retail, manufacturing, FMCG, distribution, or luxury goods is preferred.
Familiarity with ERP systems such as SAP, Oracle, or Microsoft Dynamics 365, and POS systems.
CIA, CMA, CISA, CRMA, or relevant professional certifications are an advantage.
Strong analytical, reporting, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
Ready to take the next step in your career?
r: Develop and maintain internal control frameworks, risk registers, and Risk Control Matrices.
Conduct risk assessments, process walkthroughs, and control effectiveness testing.
Review financial controls, inventory management, cash handling, POS transactions, and retail operations.
Identify control gaps, assess root causes, and recommend corrective actions.
Monitor remediation plans and ensure timely resolution of control weaknesses.
Support internal audits, financial reporting controls, policy compliance, and governance initiatives.
Prepare internal control reports and communicate findings to relevant stakeholders.
Guide junior team members and collaborate with cross-functional departments.
